summary.text: Michael A. Woelfel is a Democratic member of the West Virginia Senate from District 5, listed with Cabell County; the district covers parts of Cabell and Wayne counties. His legislative page lists him as Minority Leader.

paragraphs.text: Woelfel's page lists a B.A. in history from Marshall University and a J.D. from West Virginia University, and his occupation as lawyer.
It gives his birthplace as Hurricane, West Virginia, names his spouse as Julia, and lists two children, Michael and Matthew, and three grandchildren.
His page lists St. Joseph Catholic Church as an affiliation.

Woelfel's Senate committee assignments include Agriculture, Confirmations, Economic Development, Enrolled Bills, Finance, Government Organization, Military, Pensions, Rules and Workforce, along with the Select Committees on School Choice and on Substance Use Disorder and Mental Health.
